name: table-global-3d-ar-preview
title: Add global table 3D and AR preview
description: Add one manager-level preview modal for choosing existing, online, or uploaded table models and checking them in camera AR without attaching data to a concrete table.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Completed a global preview-only flow. It reuses the existing local/online catalog, URL import, authenticated GLB upload, camera fallback, and model-viewer native AR. The modal is lazy-loaded and follows the shared manager restaurant selection. No per-table visualConfig, AR-derived coordinates, apply action, table mutation, or GraphQL operation was restored. The GitHub connector had no runnable checkout or CI status, so Vitest, Playwright, GraphQL checks, build, and real-device AR validation were not executed.
